get_account.title: Get account
get_account.description: Read the AssemblyAI account behind the API key, the connector's own verification call. Use it to confirm the key works before submitting audio.

output.description: The account record for the API key.

list_transcripts.title: List transcripts
list_transcripts.description: To retrieve your transcriptions on our EU server, replace `api.assemblyai.com` with `api.eu.assemblyai.com`. Retrieve a list of transcripts you created. Transcripts are sorted from newest to oldest and can be retrieved for the last 30 days of usage. The previous URL always points to a page with older transcripts. Pagination This endpoint returns paginated results. The response includes a `page_details` object with the following properties: - `page_details.limit` - Maximum number of transcripts per page. - `page_details.result_count` - Total number of transcripts returned on the current page.

limit.description: Maximum amount of transcripts to retrieve

created_on.description: Only get transcripts created on this date

before_id.description: Get transcripts that were created before this transcript ID

after_id.description: Get transcripts that were created after this transcript ID

throttled_only.description: Only get throttled transcripts, overrides the status filter

output.description: A list of transcripts. Transcripts are sorted from newest to oldest. The previous URL always points to a page with older transcripts.

page_details.description: Details of the transcript page. Transcripts are sorted from newest to oldest. The previous URL always points to a page with older transcripts.

create_transcript.title: Transcribe audio
create_transcript.description: To use our EU server for transcription, replace `api.assemblyai.com` with `api.eu.assemblyai.com`. Create a transcript from a media file that is accessible via a URL.

audio_url.description: The URL of the audio or video file to transcribe.

audio_end_at.description: The point in time, in milliseconds, to stop transcribing in your media file. See Set the start and end of the transcript for more details.

audio_start_from.description: The point in time, in milliseconds, to begin transcribing in your media file. See Set the start and end of the transcript for more details.

auto_chapters.description: Enable Auto Chapters, can be true or false. Requires `punctuate` to be `true`, and cannot be enabled together with `summarization`. Deprecated - use LLM Gateway instead for more flexible chapter summaries. See the updated Auto Chapters page for details. Note: This parameter is only supported for the Universal-2 model. Provider default: False.

auto_highlights.description: Enable Key Phrases, either true or false. Provider default: False.

content_safety.description: Enable Content Moderation, can be true or false. Provider default: False.

content_safety_confidence.description: The confidence threshold for the Content Moderation model. Values must be between 25 and 100. Requires `content_safety` to be enabled; otherwise it's ignored. Provider default: 50.

custom_spelling.description: Customize how words are spelled and formatted using to and from values. Each `to` value must be a single word, and each `from` phrase can contain at most 5 words. See Custom Spelling for more details. Each item is an object. Fields: from, to. Required: from, to.

disfluencies.description: Transcribe Filler Words, like "umm", in your media file; can be true or false. Supported on Universal-3.5 Pro and Universal-2. Provider default: False.

domain.description: Enable domain-specific transcription models to improve accuracy for specialized terminology. Set to `"medical-v1"` to enable Medical Mode for improved accuracy of medical terms such as medications, procedures, conditions, and dosages. Supported languages: English (`en`), Spanish (`es`), German (`de`), French (`fr`).

entity_detection.description: Enable Entity Detection, can be true or false. Provider default: False.

filter_profanity.description: Filter profanity from the transcribed text, can be true or false. See Profanity Filtering for more details. Provider default: False.

format_text.description: Enable Text Formatting, can be true or false. Provider default: True.

iab_categories.description: Enable Topic Detection, can be true or false. Provider default: False.

keyterms_prompt.description: Improve accuracy with up to 200 (for Universal-2) or 1000 (for Universal-3.5 Pro) domain-specific words or phrases (maximum 6 words per phrase). See Keyterms Prompting for more details.

language_code.description: The language of your audio file. Possible values are found in Supported Languages. If you don't specify a language, it's detected automatically. Cannot be used together with `language_detection`.

language_codes.description: The language codes of your audio file. Used for Code switching One of the values specified must be `en`. Allowed items include: en, en_au, en_uk, en_us, es, fr, de, it, pt, nl, af, sq, am, ar, hy, as, az, ba, eu, be, bn, bs, br, bg, my.

language_confidence_threshold.description: The confidence threshold for the automatically detected language. An error will be returned if the language confidence is below this threshold. Defaults to 0. Can only be set when `language_detection` is enabled. See Automatic Language Detection for more details.

language_detection.description: Automatic language detection identifies the spoken language and routes the request to the best model. It's applied automatically when you don't specify a `language_code`. Set to `false` only together with a `language_code`; disabling it without specifying a language returns an error.

language_detection_options.description: Specify options for Automatic Language Detection. Fields: expected_languages, fallback_language, code_switching, code_switching_confidence_threshold, localization, on_no_speech_detected.

multichannel.description: Enable Multichannel transcription, can be true or false. Provider default: False.

prompt.description: Provide natural language prompting of up to 1,500 words of contextual information to the model. See the Prompting Guide for best practices. Note: This parameter is only supported for the Universal-3.5 Pro model.

punctuate.description: Enable Automatic Punctuation, can be true or false. Provider default: True.

redact_pii.description: Redact PII from the transcribed text using the Redact PII model, can be true or false. Requires `format_text` to be `true`. See PII Redaction for more details. Provider default: False.

redact_pii_audio.description: Generate a copy of the original media file with spoken PII "beeped" out, can be true or false. Requires `redact_pii` to be `true`. See PII redaction for more details. Provider default: False.

redact_pii_audio_options.description: Specify options for PII redacted audio files. Fields: return_redacted_no_speech_audio, override_audio_redaction_method.

redact_pii_audio_quality.description: Controls the filetype of the audio created by redact_pii_audio. Currently supports mp3 (default) and wav. See PII redaction for more details.

redact_pii_policies.description: The list of PII Redaction policies to enable. See PII redaction for more details.

redact_pii_sub.description: The replacement logic for detected PII, can be `entity_name` or `hash`. See PII redaction for more details. Provider default: hash.

redact_pii_return_unredacted.description: When set to `true`, returns the original unredacted transcript alongside the redacted one in the same response. Requires `redact_pii` to be `true`, otherwise a 400 error is returned. When enabled, the response includes the additional fields `unredacted_text`, `unredacted_words`, and `unredacted_utterances`. The existing `text`, `words`, and `utterances` fields remain fully redacted. Provider default: False.

redact_static_entities.description: A map of user-defined terms to redact, where each key is a redaction label and each value is a list of exact terms to match (e.g. `{ "INTERNAL_TOOL": ["Bearclaw", "Cubclaw"] }`). Each matching term in the transcript is redacted using the `redact_pii_sub` substitution, on top of standard PII Redaction.

sentiment_analysis.description: Enable Sentiment Analysis, can be true or false. Requires `punctuate` to be `true`. Provider default: False.

speaker_labels.description: Enable Speaker diarization, can be true or false. Requires `punctuate` to be `true`. Provider default: False.

speaker_options.description: Specify options for Speaker diarization. Use this to set a range of possible speakers. Requires `speaker_labels` to be `true`, and cannot be used together with `speakers_expected`. When both bounds are set, `min_speakers_expected` must be less than or equal to `max_speakers_expected`. Fields: min_speakers_expected, max_speakers_expected, include_speaker_confidence.

speakers_expected.description: Tells the speaker label model how many speakers it should attempt to identify. Requires `speaker_labels` to be `true` and must be a positive integer; cannot be used together with `speaker_options`. See Set number of speakers expected for more details.

speech_models.description: Optional. Supported values: `universal-3-5-pro`, `universal-2`. If omitted, defaults to `["universal-3-5-pro", "universal-2"]`. See Model Selection for available models and routing behavior.

speech_threshold.description: Reject audio files that contain less than this fraction of speech. Valid values are in the range [0, 1] inclusive. See Speech Threshold for more details. Provider default: 0.

speech_understanding.description: Enable speech understanding tasks like Translation, Speaker Identification, and Custom Formatting. See the task-specific docs for available options and configuration. Fields: request. Required: request.

summarization.description: Enable Summarization, can be true or false. Requires both `punctuate` and `format_text` to be `true`, and cannot be enabled together with `auto_chapters`. Deprecated - use LLM Gateway instead for more flexible summaries. See the updated Summarization page for details. Note: This parameter is only supported for the Universal-2 model. Provider default: False.

summary_model.description: The model to summarize the transcript

remove_audio_tags.description: Universal-3.5 Pro generates rich transcripts that can include inline annotations such as audio event markers and speaker cues. Set to `"all"` to remove all inline annotations, or `"speaker"` to remove only speaker cues while keeping other annotations. By default, all inline annotations are removed. Note: This parameter is only supported for the Universal-3.5 Pro model.

temperature.description: Control the amount of randomness injected into the model's response. See the Prompting Guide for more details. Note: This parameter only takes effect on the Universal-3.5 Pro model. Provider default: 0.0.

webhook_auth_header_name.description: The header name to be sent with the transcript completed or failed webhook requests. Must be 1-1000 characters and contain only ASCII letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores. Requires `webhook_auth_header_value` and `webhook_url` to also be set.

webhook_auth_header_value.description: The header value to send back with the transcript completed or failed webhook requests for added security. Must be 1-1000 characters and must not contain carriage returns or newlines. Requires `webhook_auth_header_name` and `webhook_url` to also be set.

webhook_url.description: The URL to which we send webhook requests.

custom_topics.description: This parameter does not currently have any functionality attached to it. Provider default: False.

speech_model.description: This parameter has been replaced with the `speech_models` parameter, learn more about the `speech_models` parameter here.

topics.description: This parameter does not currently have any functionality attached to it.

output.description: Transcript created and queued for processing

audio_channels.description: The number of audio channels in the audio file. This is only present when multichannel is enabled.

audio_duration.description: The duration of this transcript object's media file, in seconds

audio_end_at.description: The point in time, in milliseconds, in the file at which the transcription was terminated. See Set the start and end of the transcript for more details.

audio_start_from.description: The point in time, in milliseconds, in the file at which the transcription was started. See Set the start and end of the transcript for more details.

audio_url.description: The URL of the media that was transcribed

auto_chapters.description: Whether Auto Chapters is enabled, can be true or false. Deprecated - use LLM Gateway instead for more flexible chapter summaries.

auto_highlights.description: Whether Key Phrases is enabled, either true or false

auto_highlights_result.description: An array of results for the Key Phrases model, if it is enabled. See Key Phrases for more information.

chapters.description: An array of temporally sequential chapters for the audio file. See Auto Chapters for more information.

confidence.description: The confidence score for the transcript, between 0.0 (low confidence) and 1.0 (high confidence)

content_safety.description: Whether Content Moderation is enabled, can be true or false

content_safety_labels.description: An array of results for the Content Moderation model, if it is enabled. See Content moderation for more information.

custom_spelling.description: Customize how words are spelled and formatted using to and from values. Each `to` value must be a single word, and each `from` phrase can contain at most 5 word…

disfluencies.description: Transcribe Filler Words, like "umm", in your media file; can be true or false. Supported on Universal-3.5 Pro and Universal-2.

get_transcript_subtitles.title: Get subtitles for transcript
get_transcript_subtitles.description: To retrieve your transcriptions on our EU server, replace `api.assemblyai.com` with `api.eu.assemblyai.com`. Export your transcript in SRT or VTT format to use with a video player for subtitles and closed captions.

chars_per_caption.description: The maximum number of characters per caption

output.description: The subtitle file as text, in SRT or WebVTT format.

get_transcript_sentences.title: Get sentences in transcript
get_transcript_sentences.description: To retrieve your transcriptions on our EU server, replace `api.assemblyai.com` with `api.eu.assemblyai.com`. Get the transcript split by sentences. The API will attempt to semantically segment the transcript into sentences to create more reader-friendly transcripts.

id.description: The unique identifier for the transcript

confidence.description: The confidence score for the transcript

audio_duration.description: The duration of the audio file in seconds

sentences.description: An array of sentences in the transcript

get_transcript_paragraphs.title: Get paragraphs in transcript
get_transcript_paragraphs.description: To retrieve your transcriptions on our EU server, replace `api.assemblyai.com` with `api.eu.assemblyai.com`. Get the transcript split by paragraphs. The API will attempt to semantically segment your transcript into paragraphs to create more reader-friendly transcripts.

id.description: The unique identifier of your transcript

confidence.description: The confidence score for the transcript

audio_duration.description: The duration of the audio file in seconds

paragraphs.description: An array of paragraphs in the transcript

search_transcript_words.title: Search words in transcript
search_transcript_words.description: To search through a transcription created on our EU server, replace `api.assemblyai.com` with `api.eu.assemblyai.com`. Search through the transcript for keywords. You can search for individual words, numbers, or phrases containing up to five words or numbers.

words.description: Keywords to search for. Takes one value per call.

total_count.description: The total count of all matched instances. For e.g., word 1 matched 2 times, and word 2 matched 3 times, `total_count` will equal 5.

get_redacted_audio.title: Get redacted audio
get_redacted_audio.description: To retrieve the redacted audio on the EU server, replace `api.assemblyai.com` with `api.eu.assemblyai.com` in the `GET` request above. Redacted audio files are only available for 24 hours. Make sure to download the file within this time frame. Retrieve the redacted audio object containing the status and URL to the redacted audio.

output.description: The redacted audio object containing the status and URL to the redacted audio

status.description: The status of the redacted audio

redacted_audio_url.description: The URL of the redacted audio file

create_chat_completion.title: Create a chat completion
create_chat_completion.description: To use our EU server for LLM Gateway, replace `llm-gateway.assemblyai.com` with `llm-gateway.eu.assemblyai.com`. Generates a response from a model given a prompt or a series of messages.

messages.description: A list of messages comprising the conversation so far. Each item is an object. One of: UserAssistantSystemMessage, ToolMessage.

prompt.description: A simple string prompt. The API will automatically convert this into a user message.

transcript_id.description: Optional. The ID of an AssemblyAI transcript whose text replaces the first `{{ transcript }}` tag in the prompt. See Inject a transcript by ID for substitution rules and edge cases.

model.description: The ID of the model to use for this request. See LLM Gateway Overview for available models.

model_region.description: Optional. Routes the request to the provider's global (non-region) endpoints for lower-cost processing. The only accepted value is `global`; omit this field for default in-region processing. Currently live for Anthropic Claude models, with Google Gemini 3 series coming soon.

max_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the completion. Default is 1000.

temperature.description: Controls randomness. Lower values produce more deterministic results.

stream.description: When true, responses are streamed as server-sent events (SSE). Supported on OpenAI models only. Provider default: False.

tools.description: A list of tools the model may call. Each item is an object. Fields: type, function. Required: type, function.

tool_choice.description: Controls which (if any) function is called by the model.

response_format.description: Specifies the format of the model's response. Use `json_schema` type to constrain the model to output valid JSON matching a schema. Fields: type, json_schema. Required: type, json_schema.

fallbacks.description: An array of fallback objects. Each object must include a `model` and can optionally override any field from the original request. If the primary model fails, the LLM Gateway tries each fallback in order until one succeeds. See Specify fallback models for more details. Each item is an object. Fields: model, messages, max_tokens, temperature. Required: model.

fallback_config.description: Configuration for fallback behavior. See Specify fallback models for more details. Fields: retry, depth.

post_processing_steps.description: An ordered list of post-processing steps to apply to the model's response after generation. Currently supports `json-repair`, which automatically fixes malformed JSON in LLM Gateway content responses. See Post-processing for details. Each item is an object. Fields: type. Required: type.

output.description: Successful response containing the model's choices.

choices.description: Each item is an object. Fields: message, finish_reason.

request.description: A copy of the original request, excluding `prompt` and `messages`.

usage.description: Fields: input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens. Required: input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens.

http_status_code.description: The HTTP status code of the response

llm_status_code.description: The status code from the LLM provider

create_speech_understanding.title: Process speech understanding
create_speech_understanding.description: To use our EU server for LLM Gateway, replace `llm-gateway.assemblyai.com` with `llm-gateway.eu.assemblyai.com`. Perform various speech understanding tasks like Translation, Speaker Identification, and Custom Formatting.

transcript_id.description: The ID of the transcript to process.

speech_understanding.description: The speech understanding task to perform. Supports Translation, Speaker Identification, and Custom Formatting. Click into the request object below to see the available options. Fields: request. Required: request.

output.description: Successful response containing the speech understanding results.

list_llm_models.title: List available models
list_llm_models.description: To use our EU server for LLM Gateway, replace `llm-gateway.assemblyai.com` with `llm-gateway.eu.assemblyai.com`. Returns the list of models available through LLM Gateway, including the supported parameters, context length, pricing, and regional availability of each model. This endpoint doesn't require authentication.

output.description: Successful response containing the list of available models.

data.description: The list of models available through LLM Gateway.

create_streaming_token.title: Generate temporary streaming token
create_streaming_token.description: Generates a temporary authentication token for use with streaming services. See Authenticate with a temporary token for more details.

expires_in_seconds.description: Token redemption window, in seconds. The token must be used to open a WebSocket connection within this window. If the window has elapsed when the WebSocket is opened, the server rejects the session on the first frame. This does NOT cap the duration of the resulting streaming session — once the WebSocket is open the session runs for up to `max_session_duration_seconds`.

max_session_duration_seconds.description: Maximum duration of the streaming session started with this token, in seconds. When the limit is reached, the session closes after the current turn ends, or up to 60 seconds later, and this extra time is billed. If you need to finalize work before the session ends, run a client-side timer using the value you passed here.

expires_in_seconds.description: The token redemption window in seconds — the time the client has to use this token to open a WebSocket before it expires unused.

create_voice_agent_token.title: Generate temporary Voice Agent token
create_voice_agent_token.description: Generate a temporary authentication token for the Voice Agent API. Use this to connect browser or other client-side applications to the Voice Agent API without exposing your permanent API key. See Browser integration for the full flow. Each token is one-time use and can only be used for a single session. All usage is attributed to the API key that generated the token.

expires_in_seconds.description: Token redemption window, in seconds. The token must be used to open a WebSocket connection within this window. If the window has elapsed when the WebSocket is opened, the server returns a `session.error` with code `unauthorized` on the first frame instead of `session.ready`.

max_session_duration_seconds.description: Maximum duration of the Voice Agent session started with this token, in seconds. There is no "closing soon" warning event before the session ends, so if you need to finalize gracefully (e.g. play a wrap-up message, save state), run a client-side timer using the value you passed here.

token.description: The temporary authentication token. Pass as the `token` query parameter when opening the WebSocket.

expires_in_seconds.description: The token redemption window in seconds — the time the client has to use this token to open a WebSocket before it expires unused.

list_agents.title: List agents
list_agents.description: List the agents for the authenticated account. Returns lightweight records (no tools or prompt), newest first.

create_agent.title: Create an agent
create_agent.description: Create a reusable voice agent. Returns the full agent record, including a generated `id` you use to connect over the WebSocket (`session.update` with `agent_id`).

voice.description: The voice the agent speaks with: a voice id or a voice configuration object, as listed in the Voice Agent docs.

greeting.description: Spoken on connect; sent straight to TTS. Omit to listen first.

input.description: Audio input configuration. Defaults to PCM at 24 kHz if omitted. Fields: type, format, turn_detection, keyterms.

output.description: Audio output configuration. Defaults to PCM at 24 kHz with the agent's voice. Fields: type, voice, format, volume.

tools.description: Tools the agent can call. Each item is an object. Fields: name, description, parameters, http, timeout_seconds, execution_mode. Required: name, description.

llm.description: Connect your own OpenAI-compatible LLM instead of AssemblyAI's managed model. Provide at most one config; omit to use the managed LLM. Multiple configs (fallbacks) are not yet supported. Each item is an object. Fields: base_url, model, api_key. Required: base_url, model, api_key.

pre_connect_requests.description: HTTPS lookups the platform runs, in order, before answering an inbound phone call. Each can send the call's facts (such as the caller's number) and values an earlier entry captured, and captures values from its JSON response for the greeting and the conversation. Telephony only; ignored on WebSocket sessions. See Pre-connect requests. Each item is an object. Fields: http, sends, returns, timeout_ms, allow_overrides. Required: http.

input.description: Audio input configuration. Defaults to PCM at 24 kHz if omitted.

output.description: Audio output configuration. Defaults to PCM at 24 kHz with the agent's voice.

tools.description: Each item is an object. Fields: id, name, description, http, parameters, timeout_seconds, execution_mode.

llm.description: Connected LLM, if any. The api_key is write-only and never returned.

pre_connect_requests.description: The declared pre-connect requests. Header values are never returned.

output.description: Audio output configuration. Defaults to PCM at 24 kHz with the agent's voice.

tools.description: Tools (functions) the agent may call during a conversation, each with a name, description and JSON-schema parameters.

output.description: Audio output configuration. Defaults to PCM at 24 kHz with the agent's voice.

delete_agent.title: Delete an agent
delete_agent.description: Delete an agent. Returns `204` with no body. This cannot be undone.

list_agent_sessions.title: List sessions
list_agent_sessions.description: List sessions for the authenticated account, newest first. Page forward by passing the previous response's `response_metadata.next_cursor` back as `cursor`.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's `response_metadata.next_cursor`.

status.description: Return only sessions with this status.

agent_id.description: Return only sessions for this agent.

has_more.description: True when more results may be available; fetch the next page with `response_metadata.next_cursor`.

get_agent_session.title: Retrieve a session
get_agent_session.description: Retrieve a single session by ID, including its artifacts (recording, conversation timeline, and metadata) as short-lived pre-signed download URLs.

agent_id.description: Agent the session ran with. Null when no stored agent was used.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the session, e.g. `completed`.

public_close_reason.description: Why the session ended, when known.

duration_seconds.description: Session length in seconds. Null while the session is active.

config.description: Session configuration captured when the session started.

ended_at.description: When the session ended. Null while the session is active.

artifacts.description: Recording, timeline, and metadata produced by the session. Empty until the session completes.

delete_agent_session.title: Delete a session
delete_agent_session.description: Delete a session. Soft-delete a session. Returns `204` with no body. This cannot be undone.
